lupo.tuo: At night you choose, with the other werewolves, who to devour. By day you pretend to be innocent.
lupo.regolamento: At night, chooses with the other werewolves who to devour. By day, pretends to be innocent.

contadino.tuo: You have no powers: help find the werewolves by talking and voting.
contadino.regolamento: Has no powers: helps find the werewolves by talking and voting.

veggente.tuo: Every night you find out whether a player is a werewolf.
veggente.regolamento: Every night, finds out whether a player is a werewolf.

medico.tuo: From the second night you protect one player from the werewolves, never yourself.
medico.regolamento: From the second night, protects one player from the werewolves, never themselves.

indemoniato.tuo: You are human but you root for the werewolves: you win with them. You don't know who they are, and the seer sees you as innocent.
indemoniato.regolamento: Is human but wins with the werewolves, whom they do not know. The seer sees them as innocent.

massone.tuo: You are a villager. On the first night you and the other freemason recognise each other: you can trust one another.
massone.regolamento: Two villagers who recognise each other on the first night: they can trust one another.

medium.tuo: From the second night you learn whether the last lynched player was a werewolf or not.
medium.regolamento: From the second night, learns whether the last lynched player was a werewolf or not.

criceto.tuo: The werewolves cannot devour you. You win alone if you are still alive when the game ends. Beware of the seer: if they look at you, you die along with the werewolves' victim.
criceto.regolamento: Cannot be devoured. Wins alone if still alive when the game ends. If the seer looks at them, they die along with the werewolves' victim.

gufo.tuo: Each night you point at a player. With fewer than 20 players that player becomes a suspect the next day; with 20 or more (Deadly Owl) they die at dawn, unless they are a werewolf or a werehamster.
gufo.regolamento: Each night points at a player: with fewer than 20 players they become a suspect; with 20 or more (Deadly Owl) they die at dawn, unless they are a werewolf or a werehamster.
